name: pcaRobS
title: Robust principal components
description:
This function computes robust principal components based on the minimization of
the "residual" M-scale.

arguments.description: a data matrix with observations in rows.

value.description: The actual number of principal components
The actual proportion of unexplained variability
Eigenvectors, in a `p x q` matrix
an `n x p` matrix with the rank-q approximation to `X`
An `n x q` matrix with representation of data in R^q (scores)
A vector of length `p` with the cumulative explained variance from initial SPC

examples_r:
data(bus)
X0 <- as.matrix(bus)
X1 <- X0[,-9]
ss <- apply(X1, 2, mad)
mu <- apply(X1, 2, median)
X <- scale(X1, center=mu, scale=ss)
q <- 3  #compute three components
rr <- pcaRobS(X, q, 0.99)
round(rr$eigvec, 3)
